title: National Archives photos of EG&G/Sandia underground operations at the Nevada Test Site

tellings.quote: test and training range. There's a series of photographs in the national archives ranging from 1972 to at that time 1992 before uh Martin Marietta purchased Sandia back in 1993.

plain: There is said to be a series of photographs in the National Archives showing underground work at the Nevada Test Site, the government's nuclear testing ground, carried out by the contractor EG&G and the Sandia weapons laboratory, dated from 1972 to 1992. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb mentions this to Michels without naming a source, adding that the photos stop before the company Martin Marietta bought Sandia in 1993. If he is right, the public record holds pictures of the hidden underground work he links to the Pentagon's UFO effort.
